seoTitle: Get Your Monday.com API Key in Under a Minute
metaDescription: Generate and copy your personal Monday.com API token from account settings, and learn how to keep it secure or revoke it if compromised.
intro: Connecting external tools, scripts, or automation agents to Monday.com starts with a personal API token. This guide covers finding the right settings menu, generating your token, and following good security practices to keep it safe.

steps.heading: Open your account settings
steps.body: Click your account avatar in the bottom-left corner of the workspace to access profile settings.

steps.heading: Navigate to Developer settings
steps.body: Go to the Administration or Developer section to open centralized account management features.

steps.heading: Find the API tab
steps.body: Locate the API tab, which houses your personal token management console.

steps.heading: Generate and copy your token
steps.body: Generate a new API token and copy it securely to your clipboard with a single click.

steps.heading: Keep your token secure
steps.body: Know how to regenerate or revoke your token instantly if it's ever compromised.

faq.question: Where do I find my Monday.com API key?
faq.answer: It's located under the API tab inside the Developer or Administration section of your account settings.

faq.question: What if my API token gets exposed?
faq.answer: You can regenerate or revoke a compromised token instantly from the same API settings panel.

faq.question: What's the difference between a personal token and OAuth?
faq.answer: A personal API token is tied to your individual account, while OAuth credentials are used for broader app-level integrations.

faq.question: Can I control what my API token has access to?
faq.answer: Yes, Monday.com API permissions include read, write, or admin levels that affect what your integration scripts can do.
